about: Golden cases for the job URL key (docs/enterprise-v2/60 §2 UrlKeys; extension implementation: JAF.workspace.urlKey in src/lib/workspace.js). Shared so the server's UrlKeys.normalize can run the SAME cases. key = lower-cased scheme + host (leading www. dropped) + non-default port + path (trailing slashes dropped, case kept) + the query WITHOUT tracking parameters (original order and case kept), no fragment, capped at 1000 chars. '' means 'not a usable http(s) link'. Tracking parameters (case-insensitive): utm_*, gh_src, source, src, ref, referrer, lever-source, lever-origin, trk, trackingid, refid, from, iis, iisn. currentJobId is NOT tracking: it is the job identity on LinkedIn collection URLs and stays. The scheme is part of the key (http and https are different keys) - if the server keeps ApplicationKeys.url's scheme-less form, only the 'https://' / 'http://' prefix differs.

cases.name: uppercase scheme/host, www, trailing slash, utm, fragment
linkedin collection keeps currentJobId, drops trk/refId
indeed keeps jk and vjk, drops from
greenhouse drops gh_src and UTM_ in any case
http, non-default port, double trailing slash, surrounding spaces
bare host with only a tracking param
empty and trailing query parts are skipped
parameter name and value case is kept
subdomain is kept, ref and fragment dropped
mailto is not a job link
javascript: is not a job link
